To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act (California Government Code § 7920.000 et seq.) and Penal Code § 832.7(b) (SB 1421 / AB 748), I am requesting copies of all public investigative records and video recordings relating to the December 29, 2022 fatal shooting of Riverside County Sheriff's Deputy Isaiah Cordero (Badge #5662, Motor 38) and the subsequent multi-agency pursuit and fatal officer-involved shooting of 44-year-old suspect William McKay along State Route 60 and Interstate 15 South in Riverside County, California:
1. All Body-Worn Camera (BWC) footage from Deputy Isaiah Cordero and all responding deputies, SWAT/BearCat personnel, and supervisors involved in the initial traffic stop, pursuit, and final engagement on I-15 South (redacted only as required by California law);
2. All In-Car Dashcam / Patrol Vehicle Video and aviation/helicopter video footage from the pursuit along SR-60 and I-15;
3. All 911 emergency call audio recordings, Computer-Aided Dispatch (CAD) logs, and radio traffic audio relating to the initial shooting and pursuit;
4. The final incident reports, officer-involved shooting (OIS) investigation reports, crash reports, and scene photographs.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Medina Khalmatova

title: Intas Pharmaceuticals, Dehradun (FEI 3005890633): corrective actions and levothyroxine involvement

communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: Intas Pharmaceuticals, Dehradun (FEI 3005890633): corrective actions and levothyroxine involvement
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

records concerning Intas Pharmaceuticals Limited’s manufacturing facility at Camp Road, Selaqui, Dehradun, Uttarakhand 248011, India, FEI 3005890633.

This request concerns the September 8–17, 2025 inspection, the Form FDA 483 issued September 17, 2025, and Warning Letter 320-26-57, dated March 30, 2026, MARCS-CMS 721151.
I seek records documenting how Intas has responded to these findings, whether FDA considers the corrective actions adequate, and whether levothyroxine products were involved.
Please provide the following records from September 8, 2025 through the date of FDA’s search, including earlier supporting records attached to or incorporated into responsive submissions:

1. Company responses and supporting materials

Intas’s October 8, 2025 response to the Form FDA 483; all subsequent correspondence supplementing that response; and all responses to the March 30, 2026 warning letter, including attachments, corrective and preventive action plans, progress reports, revised completion schedules, consultant reports, and evidence of implementation and effectiveness.

Please include the assessments, investigations, and remediation reports FDA specifically requested in the warning letter.

2. FDA’s assessment and current compliance status

Substantive FDA reviews of the company’s responses; deficiency letters and requests for additional information; related company replies; meeting minutes, including any Post-Warning Letter Meeting; and memoranda documenting whether corrective actions were adequate, incomplete, accepted, or awaiting verification.

Please also provide the September 2025 Establishment Inspection Report and releasable exhibits, final inspection classification and supporting decisional records, any subsequent inspection records addressing these findings, and any warning-letter closeout or further compliance-action records.

3. Recurring assay failures, stability, and product impact

Records submitted to or generated by FDA concerning:

- The recurring subpotent stability results and shelf-life changes described in Observation 1 and the warning letter;
- The approximately 22 confirmed out-of-specification stability results reported since May 2023;
- Investigations DND/PQC1/F/OOS/2025/0072 and DND/PQC1/F/OOS/2025/0100, including any variations in formatting of those identifiers;
- The revised assay/sample-preparation method implemented in July 2025, its validation, and investigations distinguishing incomplete extraction from actual product degradation;
- Testing of distributed U.S. batches, reserve samples, and batches sharing the same active ingredient lot; and
- Related field alert reports, health hazard evaluations, and assessments correlating low-assay batches with complaints or adverse events.

4. Electronic-record integrity and remediation

Retrospective reviews of communications with software vendors and changes to completed batch records; associated deviations, investigations, and corrective actions; product-impact assessments; and FDA’s evaluations of those materials.

Please include effectiveness checks and follow-up records concerning the third-party Data Integrity Risk Assessment conducted in 2024, as referenced in the warning letter.

5. Identification of affected products and levothyroxine involvement

Records identifying the drug products, active ingredients, strengths, batches, application numbers, NDCs, U.S. labelers, and distributors associated with the redacted products in the September 2025 Form FDA 483 and March 2026 warning letter.

Please specifically include records establishing whether levothyroxine sodium, including levothyroxine sodium hydrate and finished-dose levothyroxine tablets of any strength or brand, was:

- Involved in the cited assay failures, stability failures, recalls, or altered electronic batch records;
- Included in retrospective testing, product-impact assessments, or corrective actions; or
- Determined to be unaffected or excluded from an investigation, including the supporting rationale.

Please search by the facility and inspection identifiers as well as product names; responsive records may identify products only by codes, batch numbers, or application numbers.

This request seeks existing records and does not ask FDA to conduct a new analysis. Please search the relevant CDER Office of Compliance/Office of Manufacturing Quality and Office of Inspections and Investigations files, and route portions elsewhere within FDA as appropriate.

I already possess the three Forms FDA 483 in my source collection and the published warning letter and do not seek duplicate copies. Please prioritize company responses and FDA’s substantive evaluations for rolling production.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Emma Yasinski

title: EAST program plans, sampling targets, and testing protocols

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

related to FDA’s Enhanced Approach for Sampling and Testing (EAST) initiative, announced November 18, 2026:

Program plans: The final or currently operative program charter, implementation plan, operating plan, or equivalent documents describing EAST’s objectives, scope, implementation schedule, responsible offices, and participating laboratories.

Numerical targets: Records establishing approved targets, projections, or performance measures for the number of drug products, active ingredients, samples, lots, manufacturers, or manufacturing sites to be sampled, screened, or tested under EAST, including associated timeframes, counting definitions, and baseline figures used to measure expansion over previous testing programs.

Sampling and product selection: The final or currently operative sampling plans, selection criteria, or sampling instructions specifying which products to include, prioritize, or exclude. This includes allocations by therapeutic class, dosage form, brand or generic status, prescription or over-the-counter status, manufacturer, and country or region of manufacture; and any methodology for representative or risk-based sampling.

Testing methods and protocols: The final or currently operative protocols, standard operating procedures, or equivalent documents identifying the rapid screening technologies, instruments, analytical methods, and conventional tests used under EAST. Please include records specifying which quality attributes each method assesses, screening thresholds, and criteria for additional or confirmatory testing.

Pilot evaluations: Final reports, completed evaluations, or summary presentations documenting any pilot or feasibility testing conducted to develop EAST, including findings on throughput, costs, product coverage, analytical performance, and changes recommended or adopted.

If a requested plan or protocol has no final version, please provide its most recent operative or working version.

Please direct the search to the Center for Drug Evaluation and Research’s Office of Pharmaceutical Quality and the FDA offices and laboratories responsible for implementing EAST. This request seeks the specified operational and technical records, rather than a general search of employee email correspondence.

The initiative is described here:
https://www.fda.gov/drugs/science-and-research-drugs/fdas-enhanced-approach-sampling-and-testing

Please provide records electronically, with searchable PDFs for documents and native files for spreadsheets where reasonably available. 
Please provide rolling releases as records become available.

If clarification or narrowing is necessary, please contact me before changing the scope. If no responsive records are located for a particular numbered item, please identify that item in the response.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Emma Yasinski
